Posted 'Kiffix' dested Kiffex (Jabba's Palace), the Light printing.
Posted 'I-on Cannon' x4 (under 'Devices') dested SW-4 Ion Cannon, the Light starship weapon (plain Ion Cannon is Dark); precedent in other Hidden Base B-wing lists.
Posted 'Slanting And Corpial Facilities' dested Slayn & Korpil Facilities (the B-wing factory Effect).
Wise Advice is an Effect in 2001 (not a Defensive Shield).
The deck's B-wing Bomber line is posted as 'B-wing Bomber 12' (quantity 12).
